mapper.sql: id, from_user, from_name, to_user, to_name, content, read_flag, create_time, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_time_text
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (from_user, from_name, to_user, to_name, content) VALUES (#{fromUser}, #{fromName}, #{toUser}, #{toName}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user = #{userA} AND to_user = #{userB}) OR (from_user = #{userB} AND to_user = #{userA}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET read_flag = 1 WHERE from_user = #{fromUser} AND to_user = #{toUser} AND read_flag = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user = #{userA} AND to_user = #{userB}) OR (from_user = #{userB} AND to_user = #{userA})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user = #{toUser} AND read_flag = 0

SELECT t.partner_id AS partnerId, m.from_name AS fromName, m.to_name AS toName, m.content AS lastContent, DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastTimeText, t.unread AS unread FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user = #{me} THEN to_user ELSE from_user END AS partner_id, MAX(id) AS last_id, SUM(CASE WHEN to_user = #{me} AND read_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread FROM chat_message WHERE from_user = #{me} OR to_user = #{me} GROUP BY partner_id ) t JOIN chat_message m ON m.id = t.last_id ORDER BY t.last_id DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_type AS userType, COALESCE(s.name, i.name) AS userName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN student s ON u.ref_id = s.id AND u.user_type = 'STUDENT' LEFT JOIN instructor i ON u.ref_id = i.id AND u.user_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' WHERE u.user_type IN ('STUDENT', 'INSTRUCTOR') AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY u.user_type, u.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, 'STUDENT' AS userType, s.name AS userName FROM takes t JOIN takes t2 ON t2.course_id = t.course_id AND t2.sec_id = t.sec_id AND t2.semester = t.semester AND t2.year = t.year JOIN student s ON s.id = t2.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.ref_id = s.id AND u.user_type = 'STUDENT' WHERE t.id = #{studentId} AND t2.id <> #{studentId} AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, 'INSTRUCTOR' AS userType, i.name AS userName FROM takes t JOIN teaches tc ON tc.course_id = t.course_id AND tc.sec_id = t.sec_id AND tc.semester = t.semester AND tc.year = t.year JOIN instructor i ON i.id = tc.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.ref_id = i.id AND u.user_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' WHERE t.id = #{studentId} AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY i.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, 'STUDENT' AS userType, s.name AS userName FROM teaches tc JOIN takes t ON t.course_id = tc.course_id AND t.sec_id = tc.sec_id AND t.semester = tc.semester AND t.year = tc.year JOIN student s ON s.id = t.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.ref_id = s.id AND u.user_type = 'STUDENT' WHERE tc.id = #{instructorId} AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, 'INSTRUCTOR' AS userType, i.name AS userName FROM instructor i JOIN sys_user u ON u.ref_id = i.id AND u.user_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' WHERE i.dept_name = (SELECT dept_name FROM instructor WHERE id = #{instructorId}) AND i.id <> #{instructorId} AND u.enabled = 1 ORDER BY i.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS instructorCount FROM department d LEFT JOIN student s ON s.dept_name = d.dept_name LEFT JOIN instructor i ON i.dept_name = d.dept_name GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name
